verdict.rationale: PayPal provides an official MCP server and agent toolkit (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, etc.) enabling natural-language operation of payment workflows (create orders, refunds, disputes, catalog), and ACP/UCP flows let end-customers check out conversationally via ChatGPT/Gemini. However, this is aimed at merchants/developers integrating agentic commerce rather than an end-user natural-language interface to PayPal itself, and access to Store Sync/agentic commerce services is form-gated, not self-serve. missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence of natural-language operation working end-to-end, evidence of a direct consumer-facing NL interface (vs merchant-side tooling), and confirmation the gated access doesn't limit real-world usability.
